summary.intent: Make `callisto init` work in a Git repo that has no recognized manifest by treating `callisto.toml` as a workspace root marker and falling back to the Git toplevel when no root is found. The session also needed to sort out a docs conflict between two stacked PRs (#360 and #361).
summary.outcome: Edited root discovery (locate/root.rs, locate/mod.rs) and the init command (commands/init.rs) to add the callisto.toml marker and the Git-toplevel fallback, then rebuilt and ran init in the no-root repo. The WIP was committed on its own branch, and #360 was merged into the #361 branch to resolve the conflict. The transcript does not show whether the final probe or the merge succeeded.

repo: Root discovery lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs and is re-exported through locate/mod.rs.
`callisto init` in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init.rs resolves its root through the same workspace resolution, and its error is wrapped in an init-specific shape.
An empty `callisto.toml` does not currently root a repo that has no manifest.
PRs #360 and #361 both edit the error-count line in docs/errors.md, so they conflict unless stacked.
Work is done in git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ (e.g. smoke-main).

code.finding: Root discovery now treats callisto.toml as a workspace marker. The transcript gives no line numbers.
init falls back to the Git toplevel when no root is found. The first draft used a clumsy `unreachable!`, replaced by binding the InitFacts fields directly and rebuilding the error where needed.

workflow: Related PRs that touch the same doc lines should be stacked from the start to avoid conflicts.
A guard blocked merging while there were uncommitted changes, so in-progress work had to be committed on its own branch first.
A throwaway smoke script in /tmp (smoke-noroot.sh) is a quick way to probe behavior in a no-manifest repo.

friction: The #360/#361 conflict on docs/errors.md came from not stacking the PRs, which forced a merge.
A guard blocked the merge until the WIP was committed.
The first init implementation used an awkward `unreachable!` and needed rework.
Several repeated Bash calls were needed to locate where init resolves its root.
open_items: Confirm the #360-into-#361 merge resolved the docs/errors.md conflict and that the PR bases are correct.
Verify the callisto.toml marker and Git-toplevel fallback with tests and docs. The docs mentioning root markers were checked but no update is shown.
Decide whether the WIP commit belongs on its own branch or should be folded into the relevant feature PR.
